questions.prompt: If the queen were ruling wisely, the citizens would not fear war.

questions.answer: Sī poēta dulcius carmen caneret, puella libenter audīret.

questions.answer: Sī dux fortior esset, castra hostium oppugnāret.

questions.answer: Sī minister rēgī fidēliter servit, praemium accipit.

questions.answer: Sī tympana in castrīs sonant, mīlitēs arma capiunt.

questions.prompt: If you have read the poet's scroll, you know his genius.

questions.prompt: If wisdom accomplished nothing, it would not be sought after.
questions.answer: Sī sapientia nihil efficeret, nōn expeterētur.

questions.prompt: Unless I loved my country, I would be hard-hearted.
questions.answer: Nisi patriam amārem, ferreus essem.

questions.prompt: If the fields were fertile, the farmer would rejoice in a rich harvest.

questions.prompt: If you had exercised your memory, you would not have forgotten the names.

questions.prompt: If the walls had been higher, the enemy would not have taken the city.

questions.prompt: Unless a storm had arisen, the oarsmen would have reached the harbor.

questions.prompt: If the leader had heard the shouts, he would have sent aid at once.

questions.prompt: He speaks as if he knew all things.
questions.answer: Loquitur quasi omnia sciat.

questions.prompt: The boy was trembling, as though the enemy were already at the gates.
questions.answer: Puer tremēbat, velut sī hostis iam ad portās esset.

questions.answer: Flēbat quasi ūnicum fīlium āmīsisset.

questions.prompt: However much the tyrant may threaten, the brave man does not yield.

questions.answer: Quamquam mīlitēs fessī erant, per noctem contendērunt.

questions.prompt: If the rumor is true, let me flee; but if false, let me stay.

questions.prompt: Let the enemy rage, provided that the walls remain firm.
questions.answer: Saeviant hostēs, dummodo moenia firma maneant.

questions.prompt: If the general trusts his own scouts, he moves the camp before dawn.

questions.prompt: If the fields are fertile, the farmers will gather abundant grain.

questions.prompt: If wisdom accomplished nothing, it would not be sought by the wise.

questions.answer: Nisi custōdēs vigilant, arx nocte capiētur.

questions.prompt: If you do it, I shall be grateful; if you do not do it, I shall pardon you.
questions.answer: Sī fēceris, grātiam habēbō; sī nōn fēceris, ignōscam.

questions.prompt: If the road is safe, we will hasten; but if it is dangerous, we will stay in the camp.

questions.prompt: You ask me, whether into exile? I do not order it, but, if you consult me, I advise it.

questions.prompt: If your country should speak thus with you, as I have said, ought it not to prevail, even if it could not employ force?
